body:
evan: Heads-up — launching a new Dedicated GPU pool (RTX-9000) in eu-west-2 (London). Targeting high-memory inference workloads and large-batch serving. Rollout starts in 2h, will be available to Dedicated customers on the Vela plan first.

mira: Nice. Any quotas or special billing tags we should tell customers about?

evan: Yes — new billing tag `dedicated:rtx9000.eu-west-2`. Pricing will be announced to sales in the next 30m. For now, treat it like the a100x tier for quota assignment.

ops-bot: [automation] pool-provision start: pool_id=pool-rtx9000-euw2-01, expected_nodes=24, owner=@evan

jen: SRE note — initial pool will be in a single rack (AZ b). Auto-failover to rtx8000 pools in eu-west-1 if we see saturation. We should put a soft limit flag to avoid noisy neighbor issues.

tim: Can customers pin models to this pool via console or do they request capacity through sales?

evan: Customers on Dedicated can pin model versions to the pool via the Console (new dropdown under "Dedicated pools -> Hardware variant"). Sales-managed customers will get it by request and we will attach the billing tag.

josh: Quick ops question: are there any new runtime/kernel constraints? e.g., do we have quantized kernels ready?

evan: Runtime team validated float16 and 4-bit quant paths. No new compilation flags needed. For edge cases, use `runtime.beta.rtx9000_compat=true` in config.

jen: Adding a short checklist for oncall:
```
1) Watch pooling metrics: rtx9000-util, rtx9000-temp
2) If queue latency > 250ms for 3m, enable fallback to eu-west-1 pools
3) If OOM spikes occur, escalate to infra-team
```

mira: I'll update the public Dedicated docs and send a short blurb to the customer newsletter.

ops-bot: [automation] pool-provision complete: pool_id=pool-rtx9000-euw2-01, nodes=24, state=active

evan: Pool is live. Enabling burst policy: customers with burst enabled can scale to +8 nodes for 15m bursts. Default burst is off.

josh: Tested a quick run with the 8B model — latency looks good, batch throughput up ~1.9x vs rtx8000. Will add perf numbers to the ops dashboard.

mira: Reminder to regional sales: update marketplace tiles and include the `dedicated:rtx9000.eu-west-2` tag in contract templates.

jen: Postmortem note — we've added a circuit-breaker in routing so if the rtx9000 pool drops under 40% capacity, traffic reroutes to compatible pools to avoid cold starts.

evan: Closing actions:
- mira to update docs + marketplace (ETA: 4h)
- josh to publish perf metrics (ETA: 2h)
- jen to add SLO monitors + alerting (ETA: 1h)
- infra to confirm billing tag propagation (ETA: 1h)

mira: Acknowledged. I'll ping again when docs are up. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: [audit] announcement_posted by evan at 1918523456

evan: Update @here — 3h later: confirmed billing tag propagation across accounts, marketplace tile published, customers can now request pool assignments via Console and API. Closing thread.
